props.gloss_en: an olive reed with a knot at its top is susceptible to impurity
and if not [no knot], it is not susceptible to impurity
either way it may be moved on Shabbat
it is a flat wooden vessel, and flat wooden vessels are not susceptible to impurity
what is the reason? we require [a vessel] like a sack
R' Nechemya: when one turns the olives [with it], he turns it over and looks into it

supports.gloss_en: מאי טעמא? דומיא דשק בעינן -- flat wooden vessels are pure because we require [a vessel] like a sack

objections.gloss_en: אמאי? פשוטי כלי עץ הוא -- the reed is a flat wooden vessel, and those are not susceptible

answered_by.gloss_en: תנא משמיה דרבי נחמיה: בשעה שמהפך בזיתים הופכו ורואה בו -- he turns it over and looks into it (= p_hofcho_veroeh); on Steinsaltz's reading, the knot end holds a small cavity he inspects, so it is a receptacle and not a flat vessel
